reason: The transition instrument measures the produced VSIX archive: vsce normalizes the three metadata names (README.md→readme.md, LICENSE→LICENSE.txt, CHANGELOG.md→changelog.md) and its ChangelogProcessor rewrites relative links and issue references during packaging, so the baseline adopts archive naming and packaged bytes. PR #11859 removed the withdrawn organize-imports contributions, shrinking package.json 58611→58170, package.nls.json 2110→2048, and out/extension.js 1463570→1462804; the candidate baseline adopts the measured packaged bytes from CI run 32480935866 attempt 2 subject 7d31d71649166f1193bd3c32444df37ac7194606, whose tree matches current head dc8783a69 after rebase. The adopted totals are the instrument's linux-x64 current-source projection; platform bundle entries stay outside this baseline and are ignored by the instrument in current-source mode.
